'''Pietrangelo''' was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] ''[[Unitive]]'' during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

Like the other members of her crew, Pietrangelo wore black [[Leather/Legends|leather]] boots and a crisp [[blue]] uniform.
